svg.aria-label: The agent asks to run npm publish, the block-external-send guard stops it and explains why
svg.text: Claude Code wants to run a Bash command

g.text: npm publish releases a package to the public registry.
Preview it with --dry-run. Agents draft, humans send: prepare the
message or release, show it to the user, and let the user send it.
exit 2: the command did not run, Claude reports what was stopped
